# img2threejs showcase

img2threejs is an open-source workflow that rebuilds a single reference image as a procedural, animation-ready Three.js model written in TypeScript. This site is the live gallery: each study can be orbited, inspected by named part, and opened as source code.

## Primary links

- [Live showcase](https://img2threejs.io/)
- [Core img2threejs repository](https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs)
- [Showcase source](https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs-showcase)
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs-showcase/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Canonical standard prompts](https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs/tree/main/docs/standard-prompts)
- [YouTube build log](https://www.youtube.com/@hoainho1465)
- [X / @NickDevFE](https://x.com/NickDevFE)

## Pipeline

The ordered build passes are blockout, structural, form, material, surface, lighting, interaction, and optimization. A pass must clear its deterministic and visual review gates before the next one starts.
